businessVision: ProjectOS is a Universal Project Delivery OS: a local, owner-controlled system that plans, governs, executes and proves software delivery end-to-end across many projects, with no external metered AI orchestration API. V3 extends the closed V2 foundation into an owner-controlled autonomous delivery system in which the owner approves a plan and ProjectOS drives controlled, gated execution against it.
definitionOfComplete: For an owner-approved project: vision, plan, execution plan and definition-of-complete are recorded and approved; ProjectOS drives a phased roadmap under deterministic governance; every phase is validated, reviewed and evidenced before closure; production/database/external-send/payment actions are owner-gated; no external AI-agent API is required; and the owner can start, pause, gate and close autonomous execution from a single control surface.
approvedScope: Plan-governance foundation: plan persistence, plan-memory model, current-state model, active-session model
PLAN READY evidence gate and deterministic plan-status model
Immutable plan versioning and deterministic staleness detection
Plan discovery and import of existing project plans into plan memory
Owner control-plane design and the owner Control Centre surface
Local secret broker and secret-operation broker (reference-only, no raw secret storage)
Owner chat using local deterministic language understanding only
Project-session launcher and the Claude desktop bridge
Offline E2E runner, approval queue and provider-context guards
Control Centre integration with the canonical @projectos/core + agent runtime
Native desktop E2E proof of the owner surface
PolyGo governed pilot: baseline reconcile, install re-entry and one bounded non-production phase
Reliability hardening of the canonical runtime and the Phase-12 integration seam
Final V3 end-to-end closure against the definition-of-complete
Deterministic approved-phase membership and dependency enforcement before any governed phase mutation
excludedScope: Any OpenAI, Anthropic, or metered AI-agent API integration
Production deployment, staging or live external mutation, and any database mutation
Real external send (email/SMS/WhatsApp), payment or refund
Provider credential access, raw secret storage and any real ExecutionProvider implementation
Windows service, ACL, ProgramData or registry mutation, and any installation authority
Forge, HARDEN/real-worker and CD-B4 workstreams — tracked separately, not numbered V3 phases
Any renumbering of the historical numbered V3 phases 0-18
successStandard: ProjectOS V3 succeeds when the owner can approve a plan once and then supervise controlled, evidenced, gated delivery of a real project to its definition-of-complete — with no external AI API, no ungated irreversible action, and a complete audit trail — while retaining single-click authority to start, pause, gate and close.

closureDelegation.notes: ProjectOS-only delegation of routine phase closure and final V3 programme closure to the gatekeeper. Murad remains project owner and retains plan approval, plan supersession, material scope decisions and every protected action. The implementer (Claude Code) can neither approve nor close, and cannot act as either the owner or the gatekeeper. This delegation is scoped to projectScope and does not apply to any other project.
